sloka: वानरा राक्षसाः क्रुद्धा वीरमार्गमनुव्रताः ।विवृत्तनयनाः क्रूराश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत् ।। ६.५८.१८ ।।।।
transliteration: vānarā rākṣasāḥ kruddhā vīramārgamanuvratāḥ ।vivṛttanayanāḥ krūrāścakruḥ karmāṇyabhītavat ।। 6.58.18 ।।।।

translations.english: Following the path of heroes and infuriated, their eyes reeling, the vanaras and rakshasas carried out their deeds without fear.
